defect.summary: THIRTY-TWO DOOR-PINNED SOURCE FILES UNDER src/mica NAME A PRIVATE PERSON WHERE A ROLE IS MEANT. Twenty-nine carry the name in comments and in one printed sentence (src/mica/chokepoint/types.ts READER_THREW_HOLDS, which prints verbatim on live holds); three more (op1, op2, op3) already carry the P2 printed-string role words since the P2 merge and so stand drifted from their pin. A published MICA speaks of roles. TEXT ONLY: no branch, code path, threshold, verdict or assertion moves.
defect.ground: Board 2026-10-22 (audit 20:47Z, MP51 ruling 1): the arbiter ruled the re-cut ticket opens every door-pinned src/mica file that carries the name. Plan ARC_MICA-PLAN_Name-Pass-Cut_20261021 section B (row 11: the hold sentence becomes 'the arbiter holds'). Per-file table below: pin in force, sha256 at cf996d3, sha256 after, and the edits authorised. The old text below writes the personal name as <personal name>; the exact old bytes are bound by the pin and sha256 columns, and the full verbatim edit list is kept beside this draft (P2-role-words-RECUT.edits.json). Role words: the arbiter, the arbiter's, arbiter-ruled; dates and session numbers kept.

arbiter.word: Granted by the audit under the arbiter's standing delegation, 2026-10-23, on the arbiter's in-session grant ("P2 Ticket granted") and the machine-fork rulings of 2026-10-22: the thirty-two door-pinned src/mica files listed under opens take the role-word edits listed under conditions, and nothing else. Text only: comments, the READER_THREW_HOLDS sentence in chokepoint/types.ts and two test titles; no branch, code path, threshold, verdict or assertion moves (the reading aid of 2026-10-23 reproduces every after-hash from the edit lists and finds the code tokens identical in all thirty-two). In six of the files the signature also covers a printed message already changed by the P2 merge. expiresAt is the audit's fill and part of this signature.

conditions: 0. UNSIGNED DRAFT, for the arbiter's own hand. Nothing here is signed, installed or laid by the drafting seat. Install under the file name src/core-door/tickets/P2-role-words.json (the id is the file stem). Base: branch publish-1-machine at cf996d3 (full sha in 'base'). Opens = the table below exactly (32 files); one commit; the door then reads CLOSED after the re-pin of condition 2.

1. TEXT ONLY. Every changed line is listed per file below as old text then new text (line numbers are in the tree after the edit). The old text names the arbiter by personal name; the new text uses the role word. The hold sentence's new fragment is 'the arbiter holds' (types.ts). The three files op1, op2, op3 carry no further edit: their edit (printed string, P2) is already in the tree and is authorised here retroactively.

2. THE RE-PINS THIS IMPLIES: 32 entries, one per opened file: {path, from: the pin in force, to: the sha256 after, ticket: P2-role-words, ticketSha256: the sha of this file once signed, pinnedOn: the signing day}. Obtain them with 'ts-node src/core-door/core-door.ts --propose-repin P2-role-words' once the ticket is installed. A file is re-pinned once per ticket.

3. The name fence (tools/no-personal-name.test.ts, 4/4) reads green on the assembled tree: the hold sentence was its last literal. TEXT MOVES ON THE FLOOR: READER_THREW_HOLDS reaches /explain and decision records; no Tier 2 case whose prediction quotes the old sentence verbatim may span this relay.
4. Not changed: any reader verdict, ceiling line, harm class, threshold, the served declaration's hash, or any assertion in any test. Machine relay: no restart.
